[P2] Preserve non-blocking NOT_IMPLEMENTED outcomes

If an SDK declares the suite's sole requirement, `telemetry-1`, under `TestingMetadata.NotImplemented` without a matching handler, the base runner exits successfully before processing that declaration or writing reports/history. This upload consequently fails the job, contradicting the documented non-blocking policy for declared missing capabilities. Handle zero-match runs through coverage/report generation so explicit declarations produce `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` reports while undeclared gaps still fail. Add regression coverage for both cases.
